plan_a_advantages: Dedicated tempo session for threshold development.
Longer, more focused long run to build endurance.
Strategic inclusion of strength training for durability.
plan_b_advantages: More frequent interval sessions, potentially beneficial for some runners seeking immediate speed gains.
reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a more strategic approach to building aerobic base and threshold strength, with dedicated tempo work and a longer, controlled long run. Plan B, while including some speed work, relies heavily on shorter, more frequent intervals and cross-training, which could lead to overtraining and less focused development of the specific endurance and strength needed for trail running. Plan A’s structured progression, prioritizing consistent aerobic effort alongside targeted strength and tempo sessions, is more aligned with the goal of improving speed on trails.
